args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary - Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter ("Freight pricing this quarter"): Highlights quarterly freight pricing trends from Corvid Packaging, linking to a detailed article.
- Linked article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges are now tied to weekly diesel price fluctuations.
- Companion piece: Analysis finds that shippers who split their volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall shipping costs.
